method: Fresh sheets (18:18) exist for ch01-s01 to ch05-s01 only. ch05-s02 to ch06-s02 sheets date from 17:10, before the round-1 review, the clock change and the director's edits, so those shots were judged on frames pulled from render/film.mp4 with ffmpeg. Every rrweb shot was spot-checked against film.mp4.
ledgerCheck: film.json has no stages.fixes, so neither a round1-global nor a round1-shots ledger exists. The source files for 8 of the round-1 routed shots (ch01-s01, ch02-s01, ch03-s01, ch04-s03, ch05-s02, ch05-s03, ch05-s04, ch06-s02) were last modified before the round-1 verdict (17:37 local), so their routed notes were never applied. Only the director's note shots changed after it (ch01-s03, ch02-s02, ch04-s01, ch04-s02, ch06-s01 plus sets/abstract.ts and sets/agent-pair.ts). The director's 'verify only' global seek fix does NOT hold in the render: the 'runs' take still shows the tab strip in film.mp4 for ch04-s03 and ch05-s01, although the sheets do not.

issues.problem: The sheet path and the render path still disagree on rrweb seeks. In film.mp4 the 'runs' take shows the tab strip ('Overview / Bugs 6 / Site map / Test Runs / Playwright T…', clipped) above the table at 29.4–35.9 s (ch04-s03) and 36.4 s (ch05-s01). The 18:18 sheets show the same shots without it, cropped to the 'Test Runs' heading. Every crop 'verified on sheets' can therefore still be wrong in the film.
issues.fix: Find why the build render (render-report site 'build') lands on a different scroll state than sheets.mjs. pinScrolls is probably not applied, or applied before iframe assets load, in the build path. Then make qa/sheets read frames from film.mp4 (ffmpeg -ss), or add a QA check that pixel-diffs each sheet frame against the matching render frame and fails above a small threshold.

issues.problem: This round-1 critical is still present in the film. On 'pull request' (30.1–30.8 s in film.mp4) the braces and corner dots enclose the 'Environment' column header and the red-pink underline strikes through the word, one row above the first PR #3 badge. The clipped tab strip stays in the crop for the whole shot. The nine '▶ recording' chips do not line up with the seven visible table rows, and a blurred ghost chip hangs under the stack at about 33.6 s. Only the sheet looks fixed.
issues.fix: After the global seek fix, re-anchor the braces and underline on the first PR #3 badge and crop from the 'Test Runs' heading down, measured on frames from film.mp4. Give one chip per visible row, aligned to each row's centre. Remove the ghost chip. Verify at 29.9, 30.3, 31.7 and 33.6 s in film.mp4.

issues.problem: The round-1 per-shot fix pass never ran. There is no stages.fixes ledger, and the 8 routed shots listed in ledgerCheck are byte-for-byte what the round-1 reviewers saw. Every round-1 routed note for them is still open.
issues.fix: Run film-shots with the round-1 notes (merged with the round-2 notes below) and ledger 'round2-shots'. Close it with shot-ledger finalize so the next review can confirm each id at its word times.

issues.problem: The film's USP beat has no picture. The cut to the root-cause card happens at about 56.0 s, before 'time-travel' (56.44), so 'A time-travel recording can' plays over a static card. There is no rewind playhead and no re-lit 27 squares. The card still prints literal backticks, '`SidebarProjectList` trees { are not memoized }' (56.1–58.1 s), with the subject clipped (the product says the memo-less react-router Link components). The card fades out about 0.2 s early, leaving an empty plum frame at 58.2–58.33 s.
issues.fix: Hold the grid through 'A' (56.29). On 'time-travel' sweep the kit rewind playhead right to left across the grid and re-light all 27 squares as outlined ghosts (2 red stay red), with a small 'all 27 renders' label. Match-cut to the card on 'can' (57.47). Re-crop the root cause so the subject is intact, with no backticks (set the identifier in the mono face). Keep the card up to the cut.

issues.problem: The round-1 notes are mostly unapplied. The Replay plate is empty black from 39.2 to about 41.5 s, under 'Replay QA caught one'. There is no push-in on 'Sixty-seven' (43.47): the card stays at the same scale for 11 s, and the 67 ms bar and four hollow frames occupy about 30% of the plate width. On 'background refresh' (47.85–48.87) only a faint white band sweeps the ribbon. No 'background refresh · no user action' tag ever appears, so the cause is not legible.
issues.fix: Bring the faint ribbon onto the plate by 'Replay' (39.47). On 'Sixty-seven' ease the screen 1.0 → 1.5 about the ribbon, and ease back on 'No' (46.84). On 'background' (47.85) ride a small 'background refresh · no user action' tag along the refresh band into the 67 ms block. Verify at 40.0, 43.8, 45.7 and 48.4 s in film.mp4.

issues.problem: The travelling '▶ recording' chip (beat 'chip', about 72.58 s) parks on top of 'a root cause', covering 'a ro' from about 72.6 s into the blur (73.9 s). A second copy sits on the runs tile, so two chips are visible through the transition. The agent pair sits between rows 2 and 3 (y about 745/1080), and '✓ good' is about 30 px above 'rerun to confirm'. The director asked for the open strip below row 3, never touching a word. The runs tile's top edge is about 15 px from the frame top, and its Status column shows blurred green smears. A translucent ghost chip overlaps the critic node.
issues.fix: End the chip's path in clear paper (or drop the beat, since the end card already carries the mark). Move the pair below row 3 (bottom about 8% of frame, centred, scale about 0.5) with at least 40 px clearance from every word and tile. Keep every tile at least 40 px inside the frame. Remove the green smears and the ghost chip over the critic. Verify at 69.5, 71.9, 72.8 and 73.6 s.

issues.problem: This round-1 note is unapplied. 'Catch bugs that only exist in time' (77.54–79.08 s) has no type, so the film's hook never echoes on the end card, which simply holds while 'qa.replay.io' sits typed. The black '▶ recording' chip is still in the lock-up. At about 74.6 s the arriving 'End-to-end' runs into the left brace ('{nd-to-end').
issues.fix: On 'Catch' grow a smaller second line under the tagline, 'Catch bugs that only exist { in time }', with the braces parting as in ch05-s01 and 'time' landing on 79.08. Type qa.replay.io after it and hold at least 2.5 s. Fade the recording chip out before the URL types. Let the braces part ahead of the first word so no glyph overlaps a brace.

issues.problem: This round-1 note is unapplied. For 6.8 s ('It explores your app in a real browser… and runs them') the right two-thirds of the frame is empty paper. The step list is small, sits in the top-left corner, and no exploration footage appears. '1151 journeys' is only about 10 px grey detail text, never a pill.
issues.fix: Float the explore take (MARKS.explore from 'play') on the right two-thirds, cropped to the exploration player and verified on film.mp4 frames. Tick 'Explore' on 'explores'. On 'journeys' (L0302) lift '1151 journeys' off the Insights line as a legible kit pill.

issues.problem: Partly better: on 'starting over' (about 65.4 s) the bars now reset and redraw. But from 59.6 to 60.7 s ('one list fetched') the frame below the title is empty haze. The bookmark flag is about 10 px, and its three snap-backs on 'never / place / starting' are barely visible (63.4, 64.0 and 64.6 s look nearly identical). The struck cursor next to 'no keypresses' remains.
issues.fix: Start the histogram dealing on 'list' (59.87). Make the flag at least 28 px with at least 80 px of forward travel and a pulse on each snap. Swap the struck cursor for a struck keyboard glyph.

issues.problem: Unapplied. The giant typed URL is still right-anchored, with the caret at about 0.97 W (render 9.6 s), so the line is pinned to the right edge. A blurred ghost line still sits at the left.
issues.fix: Anchor the caret at about 0.78 W (the URL may bleed off the left), or centre the finished URL by 'typed' (1.71). Make the left ghost the blurred New project page or remove it.

issues.problem: Unapplied. The hook ribbon and rewind playhead that ch05-s01 pays off are never planted. 'remember to run.' in light peach sits on the peach band at low contrast. 'run.' lands at 3.56 s and the blur starts at about 4.3 s, a hold of about 0.8 s against the 1.2 s rule.
issues.fix: In the hold after 'run.' turn one hairline into a faint frame ribbon with the red-pink playhead running backwards for about 0.6 s. End the sweep on a deeper orange (about #f06a3c) or add a soft shadow. Push the blur 0.4 s later.

issues.problem: '{ in time }' completes at 1.95 s and the shot cuts at 2.79 s, a hold of about 0.84 s for the film's thesis line. The left brace nearly touches 'exist' ('exist{').
issues.fix: Land 'time' about 0.3 s earlier with the colour sweep running on, or borrow 0.4 s from ch05-s02's empty head. Add about 12 px between 'exist' and the left brace.

issues.problem: The drawn browser cards (director-approved, no rrweb) are grey skeleton bars with pink stubs. In a promo they read as loading-skeleton placeholders, which look.md's 'never: loading spinners' spirit excludes. The schedule chip reads 'Tue · America/New_York' without the time.
issues.fix: Keep them drawn but give each card one real line (a journey name or 'Run · PR #3') and a status word in place of skeleton bars. Make the chip 'Tue at 3:00 AM · America/New_York' as the product shows it.

issues.problem: At 25.83 s the small 'preview' and 'staging' pills lift out from under the URL bar stacked on top of each other (unreadable clutter). During each URL swap two URLs show at once, the outgoing one peeking below the bar (27.08, 27.75 s).
issues.fix: Stagger the lifts so the pills never overlap, or lift them straight from their slots in the bracket. Clip the URL swap to the bar's height with a vertical push so only one URL is ever visible.

issues.problem: QA artefacts are stale. Sheets for ch05-s02 to ch06-s02 predate the clock change and the director's edits, and qa/sheets still has ch05-s05.png for a cut shot. The QA 'sheets coverage' check flagged the wrong set because QA ran before the 18:18 sheets. This answers the requester's question about the UI: the shelf copy was last published at 21:11Z, before round 1's verdict. public/generated/replay-qa-promo has no review.json, and the manifest runtime is 84.25 s against 82.71 s. QA 'publish current' warns 'shelf copy is stale', so the player shows no critic score.
issues.fix: Regenerate every sheet after any clock change and delete sheets of cut shots. Run QA after sheets. Run `film:publish --slug replay-qa-promo` (generator/film/publish.mjs writes review.json from the latest qa/reviews/round-<n>/verdict.json) at the end of every film-review round, not only when the loop passes, so the shelf always shows the latest critic score.

best_moments: ch04-s02 (now drawn): the URL bar cycles staging → pr-42.preview → localhost while 'staging', 'preview' and 'local' light red-pink inside a dotted bracket exactly on each spoken word (26.5 / 27.1 / 27.8 s). Clean, airy and legible.

ch05-s01: the recording chips flatten into a frame ribbon, the red-pink playhead rewinds across it on the tape-stop, and 'Some bugs only exist { in time }' arrives as the braces part over the plum haze.
ch04-s01: a big light '3:00 AM' over five browsers that turn green one by one, a moon on 'sleep' and a 'Sep 1 … every Tuesday … Oct 6' strip. Both dates really are Tuesdays.

ch06-s01: large confident kinetic words ('every run / a recording / every bug / a root cause / every fix / rerun to confirm') with the peach-to-orange colour sweep on each tail. The closest the film gets to the reference's type-as-hero register.
ch02-s01 → ch02-s02: the full-frame typed URL pulls back into the real New project page (URL bar 'qa.replay.io'), the braces snap round the input and 'quick chat' gets underlined.
ch06-s02: the ember end card with '{ End-to-end testing · fully managed }', registration dots and the Replay mark matches the reference's tagline card.
